notes.title: Gravitorium Update v1.1.0 - Achievements!
notes.content:
Happy Saturday Morning!

Hope you all are still having fun playing through Gravitorium. Want to thank you all for the positive reviews and comments; it really means a lot!

We've got a pretty decently sized update here. [b]Achievements[/b] are in! There were several requests for achievements in the game, so we've gone through and added story based achievements and a couple other extra ones. I wanted to get these up sooner, but I took a few days off from work/coding. They're here now though, so hope you enjoy! If you already beat the game or completed the challenges necessary to unlock the achievements, they will automatically unlock for you once you start the game and get to the Main Menu. 

Here's the official list of updates:
[list]
[*]Added achievements
[*]Fixed a bug where very low (impossible) time trial scores could be posted
[/list]

Thanks again, everyone!

notes.title: Update Notes for August 10
notes.content:
Gravitorium v1.0.3 Update:
[list]
[*][b]Level Select[/b] button now in Pause Menu
[*]Standard back button on controllers (Button East) now works to back out of Level Select menus
[/list]

notes.title: Update for August 9
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you are all enjoying Gravitorium! Really happy to be getting positive feedback from people having fun with the game. 

Just a small patch out for Gravitorium today, now at v1.0.1. Some small fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed collision missing from certain walls on a few levels in the final world.
[*]Fixed the PowerCell requirement to open exit hatch on one of the levels in the final world.
[/list]
Thanks again for playing the game, and we're looking forward to more feedback from y'all!

notes.title: Game Release Delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just want to give a quick update on the status of the game release. The current release date/time is set to today, August 6th, at 10 AM. Unfortunately, we are still waiting for our build to be approved by Steam. As soon as our build is approved, the game will go live. This could be as soon as later today or tomorrow, but hopefully no later than the end of the week. 

Apologies to all who are waiting for the release. The game is ready to go, and super fun! Hopefully just one or two more days and you can all start enjoying Gravitorium!

Apologies again, and thanks so much!
